fact: The Minister of Finance and National Planning, presenting the 2026 budget to the National Assembly on 26 September 2025, proposes to spend K217.8 million to support the implementation of the Integrated National Registration Information System, shown as a line under Public Order and Safety in the 2026 expenditure table.
title: 2026 Budget Address by Honourable Dr. Situmbeko Musokotwane, MP, Minister of Finance and National Planning, delivered to the National Assembly on Friday, 26th September, 2025
publisher: Ministry of Finance and National Planning
